notes:
Inbound SMB lead — signed up self-serve (trial) and started testing hosted API. Primary contact: Sara Lowe (Head of Product). Short notes from discovery call 2026-03-01:
- Usage: chat-based support assistant + document search (vector embeddings). Started with sample flow, storing conversation history for 7d for context.
- Main privacy questions: (1) How long are request/response logs retained by Redwood Hosted API? (2) Is there a per-customer retention window and can it be shortened to 0/removed on demand? (3) Where are logs stored (region)? Data residency requirement: EU customer data must remain in eu-west-1.
- Opt-out: they need an API/console control for user-initiated deletion and a bulk purge for compliance requests. Legal asked for proof of deletion (audit log).
- Prompt storage: Sara asked whether prompts are persisted with responses and whether we offer automatic redaction of PII from prompts before storage. Wants example redaction pipeline/engineered prompt templates.
- Risk tolerance: SMB budget-conscious — would likely accept Hosted API if retention controls + opt-out available and token costs are reasonable.
- Quote from call: "We don't want to build infra for deletions — need a built-in way to guarantee we can drop user chat history within hours of request."
- Technical: backend uses Postgres + two microservices, integrates with Intercom and their existing SSO (Auth0). They prefer simple webhooks for deletion notifications to downstream systems.
- Compliance: not currently SOC2, but want audit logging, SSO/SAML for enterprise customers later.
- Current plan: pilot 3 months, ~30k messages/month, expecting growth to 150k in 12 months.
